pois.name: Anchers Hus
pois.intro: Anchers Hus is an art museum and gallery situated in the former residence of the painters Michael and Anna Ancher in Skagen, Denmark. Anchers Hus is located on Markvej in Skagen, Denmark.

pois.name: Villa Pax
pois.intro: Drachmann's House, also known as Villa Pax, is one of the major houses of Skagen, northern Denmark. Located on Hans Baghs Vej towards the western side of the town, it was built in 1829 and is now a museum.

pois.name: Skagens Vippefyr
pois.intro: Skagen's Vippefyr is a navigational light mechanism located in Skagen in the far north of Jutland. The original vippefyr, the first of its kind, was built in 1627.

pois.name: Grenen
pois.intro: Grenen is a long sandbar spit at Skagen Odde, northeast of the town of Skagen.

pois.name: Skagens Museum
pois.intro: Skagens Museum is an art museum in Skagen, Denmark, that exhibits an extensive collection of works by members of the colony of Skagen Painters who lived and worked in the area in the late 19th and early 20th centuries. Important artists include Marie and P. S. Krøyer, Anna and Michael Ancher, Laurits Tuxen, Viggo Johansen, and Holger Drachmann.

pois.name: Den Tilsandede Kirke
pois.intro: The Sand-Covered Church is the name given to a late 14th-century church dedicated to Saint Lawrence of Rome. It was a brick church of considerable size, located 2 kilometres southwest of the town centre of Skagen, Denmark.

pois.name: Skagen Fyr
pois.intro: Skagen Lighthouse, also known as Skagen's Grey Lighthouse, is an active lighthouse four kilometres northeast of Skagen in the far north of Jutland, Denmark. Designed by architect Niels Sigfred Nebelong, it was brought into operation on 1 November 1858.

pois.name: Klitgården Refugium
pois.intro: Klitgaarden is a former summer residence of the Danish royal family situated just south of Skagen on the northern tip of Jutland.

pois.name: Hvide Fyr
pois.intro: Skagen's White Lighthouse is a historic lighthouse just north of the town of Skagen in the far north of Jutland, Denmark. It was operational from 1747 to 1858 when it was replaced by Skagen Lighthouse.

pois.name: Kystmuseet Skagen
pois.intro: Skagen Town and Regional Museum is a private museum in Skagen in the far north of Jutland, Denmark.

pois.name: Grenen Kunstmuseum
pois.intro: Das Grenen Kunstmuseum ist ein Ausstellungsort in Skagen. Es wurde 1977 von dem Maler Axel Lind aus privaten Mitteln gegründet und zeigt neben seinen Werken in wechselnden Ausstellungen Werke der Moderne internationaler Künstler.

pois.name: Skagen Odde Naturcenter
pois.intro: The Skagen Odde Nature Centre, on the northern tip of Denmark's Jutland, is a museum devoted to the effects of sand, water, wind and light. It was designed in 1989 by Jørn Utzon, the celebrated architect behind the Sydney Opera House.

pois.name: Skagen Bunkermuseum
pois.intro: Skagen Bunker Museum is a private museum near the tip of Grenen in the far north of Jutland, Denmark. It is located in an old German bunker of the Regelbau 638 type which was used during the Second World War as an infirmary for treating wounded soldiers.

pois.name: Oplevelsescenter Maskinrummet
pois.openingHours: Mo-Su 10:00-17:00; Jan 01 closed; Dec 24 closed; Dec 25 closed; Dec 31 closed

pois.name: Skagen Bamsemuseum
pois.intro: Skagen Bamsemuseum blev indviet i august 1998 og er Skandinaviens første og eneste bamsemuseum. Bamsemuseet består af en lille butik samt to små etager med museum.

pois.name: Skagen Naturhistoriske Museum
pois.intro: Skagen Naturhistorisk Museum er indrettet i den gamle Højen Station, der har været rammen om museets aktiviteter siden 1991. Museet er privatejet og drives af biologerne Poul Lindhard Hansen og Sanne Christensen.

pois.name: Skagen Vest
pois.intro: Skagen Vest är en 25 meter hög angöringsfyr strax norr om Skagen i Danmark. Fyren, som är Danmarks nordligaste, byggdes år 1956 som ersättning för Højen fyr från 1892 som var utsatt för erosion.

pois.name: Skagen Fuglestation
pois.description: Tisch an dem wissenschaftliche Vogelberingung durchgeführt wird. Besucher immer willkommen.

pois.name: Hyttefadet
pois.intro: Hyttefadet er en restaurant, og det eneste diskotek i Gammel Skagen. Restauranten har åbent året rundt, mens diskoteket i kælderen kun har åben få uger om sommeren.

pois.name: Skagen Vandtårn
pois.intro: Vandtårnet i Skagen er vandtårn i Skagen, der er tegnet af firmaet G.R. Øllgaard. Det 34 meter høje tårn er opført i 1934 og kunne rumme 150 m3 vand.
